_note: What you see: The grade trend per group and period as a heatmap.
_note_nl: Wat je ziet: De cijfertrend per groep en periode als heatmap.
gemiddeld gepubliceerd cijfer per groep: average published grade per group and period, from the grades already entered
Gemiddeld cijfer per groep en periode: Average grade per group and period
De kleur zegt iets over deze tabel zelf:: The colour says something about this table itself: low, middle or high compared with the lowest and the highest average shown here. It works the same for groups with a different grade scale.
Een lege cel betekent dat er in die peri: An empty cell means there are no published grades in that period yet.
Uit de cijfers die docenten al publiceer: From the grades teachers already published. Nothing extra is stored for the map, and only teachers and administrators see it.
